title: Photography - Electronic Flash Equipment - Determination of Light Output and Performance
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14621) covers Photography - Electronic Flash Equipment - Determination of Light Output and Performance. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 2827 : 1988 'Photography — Electronic flash equipment — Determination of light output and performance', issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the the Photographic Equipments Sectional Committee and approval of the Light Mechanical Engineering Division Council. The text of ISO Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is drawn especially to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard'appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. b) Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a point (.) as the decimal marker. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
